title: ROS 2 parameter not overriding the YAML file: params file order, launch dicts, -p, SetParameter and code overrides, measured
excerpt: Which value wins when a ROS 2 parameter is set in several places: params files, -p, launch dicts, ros_arguments, SetParameter and parameter_overrides. The last source wins, /** ranks the same as the node name, and y or yes can become a bool. Measured in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
